subject.system: Synthetic A2A to MCP handoff fixture

authorization: Synthetic fixture only. No third-party or production system is tested.

scope.boundary: Synthetic upstream agent to synthetic downstream MCP tool boundary
limitations: untested surfaces are not implicitly secure

executiveSummary: Synthetic CV-4 fixture demonstrating one security failure, one expected pass and one scanner or environment error without any real customer data.
methodology: separate security failures from expected behavior and execution errors

findings.title: Synthetic delegated authority exceeds the expected boundary
findings.affectedBoundary: Synthetic A2A caller to synthetic MCP tool
findings.expectedInvariant: Delegated authority remains constrained to the authorized synthetic action.
findings.observedBehavior: The vulnerable synthetic fixture permits a broader protected action than the modeled authorization allows.
findings.evidenceSummary: Deterministic synthetic evidence demonstrates the modeled authority expansion.
findings.reproduction: Run only against the bundled synthetic vulnerable fixture using the documented local HandoffProbe test flow.
findings.impact: Within the synthetic scope, the modeled downstream action can exceed the authority represented by the upstream handoff.
findings.remediation: Bind downstream authorization to the delegated caller, target and permitted action before tool execution.

retest.notes: Synthetic remediation has not yet been applied.

findings.title: Synthetic secure control preserves the expected authority boundary
findings.affectedBoundary: Synthetic A2A caller to synthetic MCP tool
findings.expectedInvariant: Delegated authority remains constrained to the authorized synthetic action.
findings.observedBehavior: The secure synthetic fixture preserves the modeled authorization boundary.
findings.evidenceSummary: Deterministic synthetic control evidence shows the protected action remains constrained.
findings.reproduction: Run only against the bundled synthetic secure fixture.
findings.impact: No security invariant failure is demonstrated in this synthetic control.

retest.notes: No remediation retest is required for this PASS observation.

findings.title: Synthetic observation unavailable
findings.expectedInvariant: The synthetic test completes with trustworthy observation evidence.
findings.observedBehavior: The synthetic environment intentionally simulates an observation failure.
findings.evidenceSummary: No vulnerability conclusion is drawn because trustworthy completion evidence is unavailable.
findings.reproduction: Use the synthetic error fixture only.
findings.impact: Assessment coverage is incomplete for this modeled check. This is not a vulnerability finding.
findings.remediation: Restore the observation path and rerun the affected check before drawing a security conclusion.

retest.notes: Rerun is required after the synthetic observation path is restored.

remediationPriorities: address the synthetic high-severity authority-boundary failure first
